pair.name: Name
pair.repetitions_hint: How many times the code is sent per command (the Flipper uses 10).
pair.listen_hint: Press Start listening, hold the remote close to Homey and press its button a few times. Homey can hear remotes on 433.92 MHz.
pair.listening: Listening… press the button on the remote now.

error.no_code: There is no code for this button

remote.title: Remote control
remote.intro: Choose a name and icon, and add a button for each code. Give each button a label (e.g. In, Out, Stop) and load its .sub file from the Flipper (Sub-GHz → Saved), or enter the values.
remote.incomplete: is missing a label or a code.

lib.binraw_invalid: BinRAW is missing TE or Data_RAW
lib.raw_short: The RAW recording is too short
lib.raw_nothing: No usable signal found in the RAW recording
lib.fsk: The code was recorded with FM/FSK – Homey can only send AM/OOK
lib.frequency: Homey can only send on 433.00–433.99 MHz (the code is {mhz} MHz)
lib.too_long: The signal is too long for Homey ({n} intervals, at most {max})
lib.missing_signal: The signal {id} is missing in app.json
lib.rolling: {protocol} uses rolling codes and cannot be replayed
lib.unsupported: {protocol} is not supported yet – record the button as RAW on the Flipper
lib.listen_nothing: No signal heard. Hold the remote closer to Homey and try again.
lib.listen_unknown: A signal was heard but not recognised. It may use a rolling code or a protocol the app can't decode – use a .sub file from a Flipper Zero instead.
